en: With the basic setup and configuration out
of the way, it's time to finally dive into
efficiently using Codex and into all the
core concepts and features you must be aware
of and you should be able to use efficiently
to get the most out of Codex. And therefore,
in this section, we'll dive into prompt and
context engineering. We'll explore different
modes of using Codex and how to efficiently
manage your messages and what that exactly
means. We'll explore how you can use Codex
for code reviews and how you can efficiently
review changes it applied to your project.
We'll explore using MCPs and skills to
expand the capabilities of Codex or
fine-tune them for our specific
requirements.
And in general, we'll explore many more
advanced features as well that allow you to
efficiently manage your Codex sessions and
overall get the most out of Codex and use it
efficiently.
